text_block_list.text:
Surpassing the limits of her physical body 
on this grand stage, Agnes Tachyon reached 
the long-sought-after "end of all 
possibilities."

She spent a moment lost in emotion, but... 
realizing she had achieved her goal, she 
burst into triumphant laughter.

Furthermore, showing interest in Manhattan 
Cafe, who saw the shadow of the one she 
pursued in Agnes Tachyon—

Wearing a cynical smirk, she indulged in 
mad schemes to make her the next subject 
of research.
